overview.location: 4200 Genesee Street, Cheektowaga, New York (mailing address Buffalo, NY 14225) — about 11 miles east of downtown Buffalo in Erie County
overview.elevation: approx. 717-727 feet above mean sea level (sources differ — verify)
overview.passengerVolume: About 5.02 million passengers in 2025 (BTS, via Wikipedia)
overview.cargoVolume: Cargo service by FedEx Express, UPS Airlines and Ameriflight
overview.distinction: Third-busiest airport in New York State and the main airport for the Buffalo–Niagara Falls region. Marketed heavily to Canadian travelers from the Niagara Peninsula, Hamilton and the Greater Toronto Area as a lower-fare alternative to Toronto Pearson — the airport itself says it is 'mere miles from the Canadian border and the QEW'. Historically a large share of BUF passengers have been Canadian (cited at 47% in 2012 and about one in three more recently). Single terminal opened in 1997, expanded in 2001 and renovated/expanded again in an $80M project that began in 2017.

runwayDetails.note: Primary runway; Cat I ILS both directions. Multi-phase rehabilitation (runway surface, lighting, navaids) with project close-out expected early 2026.
Cat I ILS on runway 32 only

overview.dominantAirline: Southwest Airlines (about 28% market share, Nov 2024–Oct 2025), followed by JetBlue (~17%), American (~11%) and Delta (~10%)
overview.totalAirlines: 7 passenger carriers: Southwest, JetBlue, American, Delta, Frontier, United and Sun Country (seasonal)
overview.nonstopDestinations: The airport advertises up to 100 nonstop flights per day to about 30 airport destinations; busiest route is Orlando
overview.founded: 1926 (as Buffalo Municipal Airport); current terminal opened November 3, 1997
overview.metroAccess: No rail to the airport. NFTA Metro Bus Route 24 Genesee (and 24X Airport/Downtown Express on limited trips) connects the airport with downtown Buffalo. $2 one-way fare.
overview.canadianMarket: BUF actively courts Ontario travelers: no customs/immigration stop on flights to U.S. destinations because you clear the land border by car, and the airport cites an average peak security wait of 12 minutes versus Pearson's 3-hours-early guidance.

terminals.name: Main Terminal (single terminal)
terminals.status: Active — single two-level terminal. Departures, ticketing, the security checkpoint and gates are on the upper level; baggage claim and ground transportation are on the lower (arrivals) level.
terminals.gates: Gates numbered 1 through about 25 (the airport lists power charge poles at gates up to #25) — verify gate assignments on airport displays
terminals.notes: One central security checkpoint with TSA PreCheck and CLEAR lanes. The Club BUF (Priority Pass) is the only lounge, past security near Gates 6-7. The Daily/Hourly Garage (red signs) is directly adjacent to the terminal; all surface lots use a free 24/7 shuttle. Pet relief: outside on the lower arrivals level (exit right) and post-security on the departures level between Gates 11 and 14.

keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: For Niagara and GTA-west travelers, BUF trades a border crossing for lower U.S.-bound fares, short security lines and no U.S. preclearance step. The airport's own family-of-four Orlando example (Mar 2025 analysis) showed $335.99 (34%) savings vs Pearson.

peakTravelTimes.seasonalPeak: Winter sun season (Florida — Orlando is BUF's busiest route), February/March school breaks on both sides of the border (U.S. winter break and Ontario March Break), Thanksgiving, Christmas/New Year, and summer. Bills home games (Sept-Jan) bring weekend inbound traffic.

arrivalRecommendation.holidays: 2.5 hours — add Peace Bridge / Lewiston-Queenston wait if coming from Ontario

weatherPatterns.climate: Humid continental climate with warm summers and cold, snowy winters dominated by Lake Erie lake-effect snow.
weatherPatterns.commonDisruptions: Lake-effect snow bands (November-February) can drop several feet in narrow areas while other parts of the metro stay clear; whiteouts and travel bans on roads can matter more than airport closures. Freezing rain, wind and occasional summer thunderstorms cause delays.
weatherPatterns.worstMonths: December-February (lake-effect snow peaks Nov-Dec before Lake Erie freezes)
weatherPatterns.winterNote: BUF is known for strong snow-removal operations and rarely closes, but roads to the airport (Route 33, I-90, Thruway south of the city) can be restricted during major lake-effect events. Brush-off time for a car parked in an open lot for a week can be significant — covered parking at BUF is limited to Reserved Covered spaces on garage Level 1; all Triply hotel lots are uncovered.
weatherPatterns.lakeEffectSnow: Buffalo averages roughly 95 inches of snow per season; the heaviest bands often hit the Southtowns while the airport (east of the city) sees less, but conditions change fast.
weatherPatterns.note: Pack a snow brush and leave buffer time on winter return trips. Check NWS Buffalo and the airport's flight status before leaving.

savingsComparison.keyDifference: BUF's cheapest confirmed on-airport option for a week is the Long Term Lot at ~$114 with tax (Economy may be closed). Triply's hotel lots run $55-64 all-in for the same 7 days before the Triply service fee — roughly half the Long Term Lot and about a quarter of the garage. Hampton Inn & Suites is excluded because its shuttle is suspended.

uniqueFeatures.canadianGateway: BUF markets itself to Ontario travelers as a cheaper, faster alternative to Toronto Pearson: lower U.S.-bound fares, no international taxes/fees on U.S. flights, average 12-minute peak security wait. Canadians clear U.S. border inspection at the Peace Bridge, Rainbow Bridge or Lewiston-Queenston Bridge before reaching the airport.
uniqueFeatures.freeEvCharging: Three free EV chargers on Level 1 (Section F-2) of the Daily/Hourly Garage.
uniqueFeatures.reservedCovered: The only covered parking at BUF is a limited block of Reserved Covered spaces on garage Level 1 — reservation required with a $3/day fee. Valuable in lake-effect season.
uniqueFeatures.theClubLounge: The Club BUF is the airport's only lounge and accepts Priority Pass.
uniqueFeatures.lakeEffectWinter: Lake Erie lake-effect snow makes winter parking strategy (covered vs open lot, shuttle hours, brush-off time) a real decision at BUF.
uniqueFeatures.billsTraffic: Buffalo Bills home games at Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park drive inbound weekend demand from September through January.
